plMouldProjects.title: Mould projects
plMouldProjects.subtitle: Each new mould from design to the customer's approval · approved by someone other than the creator
plMouldProjects.emptyBody: Start one with "New mould project"; it moves design → trial → customer approval → approved.
plMouldProjects.pick: Choose a project on the left.
plMouldProjects.needsApprover: Waiting for a person with the approve right.
plMouldProjects.approveRule: Approval needs the approve right and must be given by someone other than the person who created the project.

cost.title: Estimated cost
cost.body: The estimate entered on the project. The mould's own cost and upkeep are on Mould costing. Visible only with "See cost and margin".

moulds.title: Moulds from this project
moulds.empty: No mould registered yet. Add it on the Mould register and choose this project.

plMouldProjects.dialogHint: Codes are saved in capitals. A buyer's mould needs the buyer.
